parse.invalid_timeout: `timeout: {value}` is not a duration; use 30m or 1h
parse.missing_frontmatter: the flow has no frontmatter with `name` and `steps`
parse.one_kind_per_step: each step has exactly one of `agent`, `gate`, `run`, `if`, `parallel` or `github`
parse.unknown_github: `github: {value}` doesn't exist; use start_item, open_pr, wait_checks, move_item or comment_item
parse.unknown_on_fail: `on_fail: {value}` doesn't exist; use ask_you or continue
parse.unknown_verify: `verify: {value}` doesn't exist; use you, self, { agent } or { command }
parse.wrong_extension: the flow file must end in .flow.md
problem.adjust_to_not_earlier: Asking for an adjustment goes back to `{target}`, which is not a step before this one.
problem.back_to_not_earlier: “If it fails” goes back to `{target}`, which is not an agent before this step.
problem.branch_output_placeholder: the output the condition looks at
problem.branch_target_not_later: “If / else” goes to `{target}`, which is not a step after this one.
problem.continue_with_required_criteria: “Continue anyway” only works when every criterion is optional.
problem.duplicate_step_id: Another step already uses the id `{id}`.
problem.empty_parallel: “In parallel” needs at least two agents.
problem.empty_status: “Move in the project” needs the column to move to.
problem.invalid_model: The model `{model}` must be provider/model, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.
problem.missing_input: No earlier step delivers {input}. Move the step or add one that delivers it.
problem.unknown_agent: No agent /{agent} in your agents or in the project.
run.cancel_after_failure: you ended the flow after the failure.
run.cancel_no_step_to_adjust: there is no step before the gate to adjust.
run.evidence_self_check_missing: the agent didn't check this criterion on submit
run.finished_message: everything delivered; review and merge are up to you.
run.resumed_message: the flow continues from the step where it stopped.
